texte:
#cooperation I IN SITU Open Call #3

As a partner of the European IN SITU platform and its representative in Tunisia, L’Art Rue is launching the third open call for emerging artists and collectives developing projects for public spaces and unconventional venues.

Following the Tunisian collective ROOF, which completed Guarret el Anz, premiered at FiraTàrrega in Spain in 2026, and Afef Omri, who is currently developing Audioclopedia ahead of its presentation at the HAPU Festival in Pristina in 2027, this new call opens the door to further projects, encounters and opportunities.

Who can apply?

Emerging artists and collectives legally residing in one of the 41 countries eligible for the Creative Europe programme, including Tunisia, with an artistic project currently in development, intended for public spaces or unconventional venues.

• You have an artistic project in development that has not yet premiered or toured, and that could be presented to an audience around summer 2028.

• You are an emerging artist or collective with a project that has moved beyond the idea stage and is intended for presentation in public spaces or unconventional venues.

• You are looking to develop your practice through exchanges with a wider network of artists and cultural professionals.

• There is no age limit. However, a basic conversational level of English is required, as English is the programme’s working language.

This third open call is for you!

Find the application form in the bio
> Application deadline: 9 December 2026, midnight (CET).

For accessibility purposes, please note that Open Call #3 is also available in alternative formats. 

This call is part of the IN SITU Platform programme, supported by Creative Europe.
#INSITU #LArtRue #PublicSpaceArt #EmergingArtists
